name: Obsidian Tasks
author: Mike Jarrett
description: Obsidian Tasks checkboxes from a local vault, in the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Counts open Obsidian Tasks checkboxes across a vault and lists them in a popup, with click-to-complete and quick add. Reads plain markdown, so anything that syncs the vault keeps it current.

schema.label: Vault path
schema.description: Folder scanned for markdown checkboxes. Left empty, the vault Obsidian currently has open is used. .obsidian, .trash, .git and Templates are always skipped.

schema.label: Quick-add file
schema.description: Where the add box appends new tasks, relative to the vault. Created on first use; a path with folders in it, like Tasks/Inbox.md, creates them. Only affects new tasks — existing ones are found anywhere in the vault.

schema.label: Bar icon lights up for
schema.description: all keeps the icon lit whenever anything is open; due lights it only for tasks dated today or earlier, so the widget goes quiet when nothing is pressing.

schema.label: Rescan interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the vault is rescanned. The popup also rescans every time it opens.
